title: Coronary angiography: find the narrowing, with and without one
description: Invasive coronary angiograms (single contrast-filled frames, 512 x 512 px), one case per image, left and right coronary systems. Most frames carry a box drawn by cardiologists around a narrowing of 50% or more, with the degree of narrowing as a category; some frames show only milder irregularities and some come from runs with no lesion at all. The boxes are rectangles around the narrowing, not outlines. No pixel size or projection angle is distributed.

sources.citation: Jimenez-Partinen A, Molina-Cabello MA, Thurnhofer-Hemsi K, Palomo E, Rodriguez-Capitan J, Molina-Ramos AI, Jimenez-Navarro M. CADICA: a new dataset for coronary artery disease detection by using invasive coronary angiography. Expert Systems 41(12), e13708 (2024). doi:10.1111/exsy.13708. Data: Mendeley Data, doi:10.17632/p9bpx9ctcv.5 (earlier versions .1 and .2).
